firstPartyCooldown.prompt: In 4, 6, 8 and 9, identify one item that differs and justify.
firstPartyCooldown.teacherAnswer: 9 is the only odd number; other justified rules can be considered.

originalSourceActivities: Warm-up: Which One Doesn’t Belong: Strings of Numbers (10 minutes)
Activity 1: Add One That Doesn’t Belong (20 minutes)
Activity 2: Add Two That Don’t Belong (15 minutes)
Activity 3: Add Three That Don’t Belong [OPTIONAL] (30 minutes)
sourceStudentExcerpts: Here are two incomplete Which One Doesn’t Belong sets, each with one item missing. For each set: | Find at least one reason that all items belong in the set. | Find at least one reason that each item doesn’t belong.

Here is an incomplete Which One Doesn’t Belong set. It has two missing items. | Find at least one reason that the first two items, A and B, belong in the set. | Add two items to complete the set. Make sure there is at least one reason that each new item belong
teacherOnlyTasks: Original incomplete illustrated WODB sets with one/two missing elements
Multiple defensible explanations from each learner
Optional third activity and original reflection Cool-down
